description: This Java class 'FeaturesCreatedStrategy' implements a strategy to handle 'FeaturesCreated' events within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It extends an abstract event strategy and overrides a method to set features on a ThingBuilder from the event data.

classes.name: FeaturesCreatedStrategy
classes.description: A final class that handles 'FeaturesCreated' events, extending 'AbstractThingEventStrategy' specialized for 'FeaturesCreated' events, and applies the features to a ThingBuilder.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to handle 'FeaturesCreated' events by setting features on the provided 'ThingBuilder.FromCopy' object based on the event data.
